target_customer: Mid-market B2B sales teams using Salesforce or HubSpot
problem: Sales teams chase leads that rarely close; the launch post cites 5 to 10 percent prospect to close rates and says better prioritisation can double win rates.
business_model: B2B SaaS lead prioritisation integrated into the CRM
product_category: Predictive lead scoring and account prioritisation

founders.name: Jacob Lauritzen
founders.background_notes: Listed under Former Founders on the YC page, bio only says hello. Background not found in an opened source.

exit.reason: YC lists as inactive and the founder as former; unhaze.ai returns 404; no public cause

competitors.name: MadKudu
competitors.what: Predictive lead scoring platform for B2B SaaS
competitors.funding_then: $18M Series A in Nov 2022 led by Felicis, per MadKudu announcement coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining firmographic, technographic, intent and hiring signals and training per customer models on past deals is standard data work, with data sourcing as the hard part for six people.

defensibility.rationale: Claimed advantage was learning from each customer's deal history, but data sources were commodity and CRM vendors offered scoring.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: CRM vendors already offered predictive scoring; no source found on specific actions against Unhaze.

market_need_then: The launch post cites low prospect to close conversion rates of 5 to 10 percent and reports pilot customers; no independent demand figures found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence found about the brand; a similarly named Everhaze appears in listings.

outcome_analysis: Unhaze raised about $500K (a YC note) and a founder listed as former suggests the company wound down by 2024 or later, but no post mortem exists so the cause is not public. The category was crowded with funded scoring vendors and CRM native features, and no later round was found.
notes: The $500K round rests on databases that disagree: VCBacked says pre-seed Sep 2023, Seedtable says seed Aug 2023, CB Insights says a YC convertible note dated 2023-01-01. Seedtable page returned 403 when fetched. Investors beyond YC not stated. Dealroom snippet links the founder to an earlier startup Firmnav but it was not opened, so not recorded.
